title: Joot Are You Ready
desc: Easwaran, a young man from a small village, and his ailing father move in with his older brother in Chennai. However, things become complicated when he gets embroiled with local gangsters.

title: Ullasa Paravaigal
desc: The son of a wealthy man suffers from a condition whereby he cannot stand the sight of fire as he has a violent outburst every time. A caring doctor and a friend help the young man unravel his past.

title: Kandukondain Kandukondain
desc: Sowmya loves Manohar, an aspiring film director, and her sister is smitten with Srikanth. However, things take a turn when both the sisters are betrayed by their respective lovers.

title: Sengottai
desc: Thirumoorthy is a corrupt politician who plans to kill the prime minister as he lusts after his position. However, Sekhar, a young police officer, creates hurdles in his path.

title: Thavasi
desc: Thavasi is a revered landlord who lives in a small village. However, his life changes drastically when a young man commits suicide due to a misjudgement he makes.

title: Thambikku Intha Ooru
desc: Akil, a restaurateur from Singapore, is taken aback after learning that he has been adopted and sets out on a journey to Chengalpet in order to find his biological parents.

title: Neruppukkul Eeram
desc: Karthik, a police officer, is determined to put a local goon called Baba behind bars. However, his fiancée, Radha, asks him to give Baba a chance to change for the better.

title: Nila Kaalam
desc: Nila, an actress's daughter, forms a bond of friendship with two boys working in a garage.

title: Kaalamellam Kaathiruppen
desc: Kannan, a man from a wealthy family, falls in love with Manimekalai, after hearing her sing in a temple, later he comes up with new ways to woo her.
